summary.text: The Brokers are one of the five crime families of New Capenna, a demonic law firm that fronts racketeering with contract magic.

bio.text: In Old Capenna the Brokers travelled from village to village making pacts of protection, which after the city's founding evolved into protection rackets.
Falco Spara is the boss of the family, whose solicitors, lieutenants and enforcers deal in binding contracts.
During the New Phyrexian Invasion the Brokers led the defense of Capenna with the Obscura and Riveteers, and Falco was a crucial target of Atraxa's massacre.
The gangs collapsed the structure holding Park Heights on Atraxa, killing her.
Perrie and the Brokers sided with the returned angels and joined the resistance.

status.text: The Brokers survive, with later stories showing their muscle on a train in Thunder Junction and Eula's father still serving them.
